body: Industrial risk-control systems typically rely on structured-data models for efficient prediction, yet substantial valuable information remains embedded in unstructured long text. Extracting this information through manual feature engineering is labor-intensive, while requiring a large language model (LLM) to process every real-time input may not meet practical deployment requirements. To address this challenge, we propose LLM-BlockFE, an LLM-guided offline feature construction framework that converts long text into executable feature programs, thereby avoiding LLM calls during online inference. LLM-BlockFE constructs feature programs by incrementally appending immutable code blocks and evaluates candidate features using a downstream model. To address the tendency of conventional greedy search to become trapped in suboptimal solutions, our method introduces a block-level rollback mechanism based on depth-calibrated credit allocation and advances multiple independent search trajectories in an interleaved manner, reducing redundant exploration by sharing fixed descriptions of each trajectory's exploration direction. After the search, the resulting programs are frozen and deployed to extract structured features for downstream prediction models. Across two public and two private datasets, LLM-BlockFE achieves absolute AUC improvements of 0.0069 to 0.0358 over the strongest baseline on each dataset in the full-dataset comparison. Post-launch monitoring across five deployed financial risk-control applications shows absolute KS improvements of 0.02 to 1.56 percentage points over the existing manually designed strategy.
summaryZh: 工业级风控系统通常依赖结构化数据，而大量有价值的信息却隐藏在非结构化长文本中。手动特征工程成本高昂，且实时调用大模型无法满足性能要求。为此，本文提出了LLM-BlockFE框架，这是一种大语言模型引导的离线特征构建方法，它将长文本转化为可执行的特征程序，从而在在线推理阶段完全避免了大模型调用。该方法通过基于深度校准信用分配的块级回滚机制以及交替推进多个独立搜索轨迹，克服了贪婪搜索陷入局部最优的问题。在多个公开与私有数据集以及实际金融风控应用中的测试表明，该框架在保持低推理延迟的同时显著提升了下游预测模型的准确性。

glossary.explanationZh: 一种由大语言模型引导的离线特征构建框架，可将长文本转换为可执行特征程序以避免在线大模型调用
特征工程，指使用领域知识将原始数据转换为能更好地表示潜在问题的特征的流程
可执行程序搜索，指在特征构造中搜索并生成可运行代码的方法
风控系统，用于识别和防范金融或业务风险的自动化系统
在线推理，指模型在生产环境中实时处理用户请求并输出结果的阶段
